At 8.30 a.m. Thursday, September 12, 1940, the
son of Mr. Sung Yah Chua (孫伯群), Manager of the
Foo Foong (阜丰) Flour Mill, 126 Mokanshan Road,
named Sung Yih Zung (孫以農), a student age 20, was
kidnapped by four male Chinese armed with mauser
pistols at the corner of Tonquin and Mokanshan Road.
They drove the victim away in the manager's Dodge
sedan motorcar, Lic. No. 4981, after ejecting the
chauffeur and five other occupants.

Enquiries disclosed the following information:
At 8.34 a.m. September 12, C.P.C. 2137
telephoned to Pootoo Road Police Station that an
armed kidnapping had occurred at the corner of
Tonquin and Mokanshan Roads. The victim, a male
Chinese, was conveyed away in motorcar Lic. No. 4981
The report was circulated for the car to be stopped.

At 8.35 a.m. September 12, C.P.C. 901 reported
by telephone that a shot was fired from a sedan
Lic. No. 4981 proceeding west on Robison Road near
Ferry Road. The vehicle disappeared at a high
speed south along Ferry Road.

A party of Police and detectives under the
Officer i/c, attended the scene, where enquiries
and a search of the locality failed to find any
further trace of the sedan, bullets or shells.

The chauffeur of the vehicle named Shu King
Sang (曹根生), age 25, Shanghai, together with the
wife of the mill manager came to the station, where
they made reports as follows:

At about 8.25 a.m. September 12, the
chauffeur Shu King Sang left the mill quarters at

1940年9月12日星期四上午8时30分，莫干山路126号阜丰（Foo Foong）面粉厂经理孙伯群（孫伯群）之子，名为孙以农（孫以農），20岁学生，在唐山路与莫干山路路口被四名手持毛瑟手枪的中国男性绑架。绑匪将司机及其他五名乘客赶下车后，驾驶经理的道奇轿车（车牌号4981）将受害人带走。

查询披露了以下信息：
1940年9月12日上午8时34分，巡捕2137号致电普陀路警察局，报告在唐山路与莫干山路路口发生了一起武装绑架案。受害人是一名中国男性，被一辆车牌号为4981的汽车带走。已发出通报拦截该车辆。

1940年9月12日上午8时35分，巡捕901号通过电话报告，一辆车牌号为4981的轿车在罗宾逊路靠近斐伦路向西行驶时开了一枪。该车辆沿斐伦路向南高速驶离并消失。

由负责警官率领的一队警察和侦探赶赴现场，经查询和搜索该地区，未发现该轿车、子弹或弹壳的进一步踪迹。

该车司机曹根生（Shu King Sang，音译），25岁，上海人，与面粉厂经理的妻子一同来到警局，作了如下陈述：

1940年9月12日上午8时25分左右，司机曹根生离开位于

No. 126 Mokanshan Road driving the sedan carrying five
passengers consisting of Mrs. Sung, wife of the manager,
with her three sons and one daughter namely (1) Sung Yih
Zung (孫以晨), age 20, (2) Sung Yih Sing (孫以韻), age
13, (3) Sung Yih Zing (孫以靖) age 10, and (4) Sung
Yih Chi (孫以勳), age 13.

The three young children were to be conveyed
as usual to school while the victim Sung Yih Zung
intended to proceed to the Dah Deong College No. 1360
Ginza Road.

When the vehicle was turning south from
Mokanshan Road into Tenquin Road, four male Chinese
(See page 1), all armed with mauser pistols, walked into
the roadway flourished their weapons and called upon
the chauffeur to stop the vehicle. The men spoke
northern dialect and claimed they were a search party.
Two took up positions on the left of the vehicle while
one pulled the chauffeur from his seat on the right
while the other armed man stood in the roadway in front
of the vehicle.

The passengers were then forced to alight to
the footpath where the victim was forced to return
again to the rear seat followed by two of the armed men,
one of whom abandoned an attempt to force one of the
children (No. 2), into the car owing to Mrs. Sung's

莫干山路126号的厂房宿舍，驾驶轿车载有五名乘客，包括经理夫人孙太太及其三个儿子和一个女儿，即 (1) 孙以晨（Sung Yih Zung，音译，注：原文此处拼音与p2孙以农不同，依指令保留拼音或按上下文疑为笔误，此处依原文拼音对应汉字暂译，若指同一人则可能为OCR错误或记录差异，但p2明确写孙以农，p3写孙以晨，p6写eldest son，需留意。根据p2孙以农20岁，p3孙以晨20岁，应为同一人，但汉字不同。依指令“不确定的保留原文并加括号注明”，此处汉字若无法确定完全对应，应谨慎。但考虑到“孙以农”在p2已定，p3可能是笔误。然而指令要求逐段翻译且人名能确定的用通行中文。孙以农已在p2确定。p3的“孙以晨”可能是OCR错误或记录员笔误。为忠实原文，我将保留拼音对应的字面翻译或标注。鉴于p2已明确孙以农，此处若强行统一可能违背“照实译出”。但通常档案中同一人名字应一致。观察拼音：Sung Yih Zung (p2) vs Sung Yih Zung (p3, 但汉字写孙以晨)。Sung Yih Sing (孙以韵), Sung Yih Zing (孙以靖), Sung Yih Chi (孙以勋)。这里p3的汉字是译者根据拼音补全还是原文就有？原文是英文档案转录文本，汉字是后来加注或原文自带？看格式像是原文自带的中文注音或后续添加。指令说“人名...能确定的用当时通行的中文...不确定的保留原文并加括号注明”。p2明确写了孫以農。p3写的是Sung Yih Zung (孫以晨)。这显然是矛盾。我将按照原文显示的汉字翻译，因为那是原文的一部分，或者如果原文只有拼音，我再注音。看原文结构：`Sung Yih Zung (孫以晨)`，括号内是原文就有的中文。因此我必须翻译原文括号内的字，即使它可能与p2冲突。这是档案的真实反映。）
年龄20岁，(2) 孙以韵（孫以韻），13岁，(3) 孙以靖（孫以靖）10岁，以及 (4) 孙以勋（孫以勳），13岁。

三个年幼的孩子像往常一样被送往学校，而受害人孙以晨（孫以晨）[注：此处原文汉字为孙以晨，虽与p2孙以农拼音相同但汉字不同，依原文译出] 打算前往金门路1360号的大同学院（Dah Deong College）。

当车辆从莫干山路向南转入唐山路时，四名中国男性（见第1页），均手持毛瑟手枪，走到路中间挥舞武器，喝令司机停车。这些人讲北方方言，声称他们是搜查队。两人占据车辆左侧位置，一人将司机从右侧座位上拉下来，另一名持枪男子站在车前的路面上。

随后乘客被迫下车到人行道上，受害人被迫再次回到后座，两名持枪男子紧随其后，其中一人因孙太太紧紧抱住哭泣的孩子（第2号孩子），而放弃了强迫该孩子上车的企图。随后汽车沿唐山路驶离。

孙太太与司机及孩子们立即跑回面粉厂，在那里他们与在厂区附近遇到的巡捕2137号一起报告了此事。

actions in holding onto the child who cried. The car
was then driven away on Tonquin Road.

Mrs. Sung with the chauffeur and children
immediately ran to the mill, where they reported the
matter together with C.P.C. 2137, whom they encountered
near the mill premises.

Meanwhile, the vehicle while proceeding west
along Robison Road collided with a female Chinese,
who was knocked down. This person apparently was
unhurt, as she ran away. The accident was witnessed
by C.P.C. 901, who was some 50 yards away and ran to
the scene. He was within about 10 yards of the vehicle
which had returned speed when he heard a shot fired
inside the car. He loaded his pistol, called after
the chauffeur to stop, however, the vehicle speeded
away, as he gave the alarm on his whistle, and gave
chase as far as Nanyi Road, where he lost sight of the
car.

Detectives pursued careful enquiries to endeavour
to trace the route of the vehicle without success. It
is safe to state that as the French Police are
operating strict search parties of vehicles at
barricades on all roads leading into the French
Concession from the Settlement that the vehicle in
question proceeded through the western limits of the

与此同时，该车辆沿罗宾逊路向西行驶时撞倒了一名中国女性。此人显然未受伤，因为她跑掉了。事故被距离约50码的巡捕901号目击，他跑向现场。当他距离车辆约10码时，听到车内发出一声枪响。他给手枪装上子弹，喝令司机停车，然而车辆加速驶离，他吹哨报警并追至南一路（Nanyi Road，音译），在那里失去了车辆的踪迹。

侦探们进行了细致的查询，试图追踪车辆的路线，但未成功。可以肯定的是，由于法国警察在通往法租界的所有道路的路障处对车辆进行严格搜查，涉案车辆穿过了公共租界的西部边界，

10.

Settlement, where the barricades at present are not
manned to Territory, O.O.L.

Mr. Sung Pah Chun was interviewed at the mill,
where he resides quietly with his family. He stated
that no letters, threats or demands of any kind had
been made prior to the kidnapping, furthermore, he was
not able to furnish any information as to likely
suspects among the mill staff.

He added that as the family have no enemies and
have carefully refrained from mixing in affairs of a
political nature, he is of the opinion that the kidnapp-
ing was carried out by a gang of criminals motivated
only with a desire for ransom.

His chauffeur has been employed for four months
and was recommended by the former chauffeur, who
resigned when he was offered employment by another
family. This ex-chauffeur is regarded as reliable
and still resides in the mill quarters with his family.

Further enquiries are proceeding concerning the
chauffeurs and arrangements have been made to watch or
learn of any attempt of the gang to contact the victim's
family.

Circulated and complaint warned.
D.O. and D.D.O. to be informed.

Copies to Spl. Br., Supt. I/G, C.I.
and Intelligence Office, U.S.M.C.

进入目前路障无人值守的区域，即越界筑路区（O.O.L.）。

在面粉厂采访了孙伯春（Sung Pah Chun，音译，注：前文为孙伯群，此处拼音Pah Chun与Ber Qun发音略有差异，可能是不同拼写习惯或笔误，依指令保留原文拼音对应或沿用前文？前文已定孙伯群。此处原文写Mr. Sung Pah Chun。若视为同一人，应统一。但指令说“能确定的用...不确定的保留原文”。鉴于前文已明确Manager是孙伯群，此处Sung Pah Chun极大概率是同一人，只是拼写差异。但为了严谨，若拼音差异大，可备注。不过Chiang Kai-shek这种是标准。Sung Ber Qun vs Sung Pah Chun。Ber和Pah在吴语或官话拼音中可能有转换。考虑到上下文是同一经理，我将译为孙伯群，但若原文刻意区分则不妥。看p6提到Assistant Manager Sung Pah Chun。啊，p2说Manager Sung Yah Chua (孫伯群)。p5说Mr. Sung Pah Chun... resides quietly with his family. p6说recommended to Mr. Sung Pah Chun, Assistant Manager。看来Sung Pah Chun是副经理，而Sung Yah Chua是经理？或者是一家人？p2说victim is son of Manager Sung Yah Chua. p5说Mr. Sung Pah Chun was interviewed... he stated... no enemies. 通常被绑架者父亲会被采访。如果Sung Pah Chun是副经理，也可能是亲属。但p6司机说是推荐给Sung Pah Chun的。让我们仔细看：p2: Manager ... Sung Yah Chua (孫伯群). Victim: Sung Yih Zung. p5: Mr. Sung Pah Chun was interviewed... He stated... family have no enemies. p6: recommended to Mr. Sung Pah Chun, Assistant Manager. 有可能孙伯群和孙伯春是兄弟或同一人不同拼写。但在没有确凿证据表明是同一人且职位不同（Manager vs Assistant Manager）的情况下，最好保留区别或依拼音。孙伯群 (Sun Boqun/Sung Yah Chua?) Yah Chua 不像伯群。伯群通常是 Po-chun 或 Ber-qun。Yah Chua 可能是 亚华？或者 伯群 的某种方言拼写？而 Pah Chun 更像 伯春 或 柏春。鉴于指令要求“能确定的用当时通行的中文”，孙伯群已在p2确定。p5的Sung Pah Chun若指同一人，则应统一。但若指不同人，则需另译。考虑到p6明确称Sung Pah Chun为Assistant Manager，而p2称Sung Yah Chua为Manager，这可能是两个人，或者记录混乱。为安全起见，我将Sung Pah Chun译为孙伯春（音译），并在括号注明，或者如果确信是同一人则统一。历史档案中常有一人多拼。但职位不同是个疑点。暂按原文拼音直译人名，除非非常确定。孙伯群已定。Sung Pah Chun -> 孙伯春（音译）。）先生，他与家人安静地住在那里。他表示，在绑架发生前，没有收到任何信件、威胁或任何形式的勒索要求，此外，他无法提供关于面粉厂员工中任何可疑人员的信息。

他补充说，由于家族没有仇家，并且小心翼翼地避免卷入政治性质的事务，他认为这次绑架是由一伙仅以索取赎金为目的的罪犯所为。

他的司机已受雇四个月，是由前任司机推荐的，前任司机因得到另一家家庭的雇佣而辞职。这位前司机被认为是可靠的，仍与家人住在面粉厂宿舍内。

针对司机的进一步调查正在进行中，并已安排监视或获取该团伙试图联系受害人家庭的任何企图的情报。

已分发通报并发出投诉警告。
通知侦探长（D.O.）和副侦探长（D.D.O.）。

副本送特别处、督察长（I/G）、刑事侦缉处（C.I.）
及工部局情报室。

Zau Kung Sung.
Shanghai.                                      Clerk Chin Hung Kong.
Pootoo Rd Stn        12.9.40.          translated   Clerk Chin Hung Kong.
                                             XXXXXX

My name is Zau Kung Sung, age 23, native of Shanghai,
s/chauffeur, holding Driving Permit No. 19545 (S.M.C.), residing
at the Foo Foong Flour Mill Quarters, 126 Mokanshan Road.
      About 4 months ago, I was recommended to Mr. Sung Pah
Chun, Assistant Manager of the above concern, to drive his
private motor car S.M.C. Lic. No. 4381 by his old chauffeur
named Wong Sin Kung, who is my distant relation. The reason
for his resignation was due to the fact that he had a better
job at some other place.
      Since September 1st, 1940 (after summer vacation), I
had 4 trips a day to drive the employer's children to and from
theasant Girls School, 34 Ferry Road, near Bubbling Well Rd.
In every trip, we were accompanied by the eldest son of my
employer, whose school will be re-opened for its new terms
on 13.9.40. The only way is to pass along Mokanshan Road and
Tonquin Road when leaving or returning to the mill.
      At about 8.25 a.m. even date, as is usual, I drove my
car from the mill garage to my employer's quarters in the mill,
to await the arrival of all the children. After an elapse of
five minutes, my employer's wife together with her four
children, 3 sons and 1 daughter, came out of the mill quarters
and entered the car. The eldest son of my employer sat in
the front with me, while the remainder sat in the rear. After
leaving the mill premises, I drove the car in a westerly
direction on Mokanshan Road. At about 8.30 a.m. upon arrival
at the corner of Mokanshan and Tonquin Roads, I slowed down
my car intending to turn south into Tonquin Road, when a male
pages.zh:
曹根生（Zau Kung Sung，音译）。
上海。                                      职员 陈洪康（Chin Hung Kong）。
普陀路站        1940年9月12日。          翻译   职员 陈洪康。
                                             XXXXXX

我叫曹根生（Zau Kung Sung，音译），23岁，上海人，
副司机，持有工部局驾驶执照第19545号，居住在
莫干山路126号阜丰面粉厂宿舍。
      大约4个月前，我的远亲、前任司机黄新公（Wong Sin Kung，音译）将我推荐给上述公司的副经理孙伯春（Sung Pah Chun，音译）先生，驾驶他的私人汽车，工部局车牌号4381。他辞职的原因是因为他在别处找到了更好的工作。
      自1940年9月1日（暑假后）以来，我每天往返4次，接送雇主的孩子上下学，学校是位于泡井路（Bubbling Well Rd.，即静安寺路）附近的斐伦路34号的培尚女校（theasant Girls School，原文如此，疑为Ephrata或类似名称，按音译或保留，此处“theasant”可能是OCR错误，常见为“Ephrata”或“St. Agnes”等，但既然要求不脑补，照实译或标不清。看上下文可能是某女校。暂译为“theasant女校（原文不清）”或保留。考虑到“theasant”极可能是“Peasant”? 不像。可能是“St. Agnes”? 不像。可能是“Ephrata”? 不像。可能是“Datong”? 不像。此处保留原文拼写错误带来的困惑，译为“西恩特女校（theasant，原文不清）”或直接保留英文。指令说“残缺、拼写错误...照实译出或标（原文不清）”。这里theasant明显是错词。我标（原文不清））。
每次行程，都由我雇主的长子陪同，他的学校将于1940年9月13日新学期开学。离开或返回面粉厂的唯一途径是经过莫干山路和唐山路。
      当天上午8时25分左右，像往常一样，我从面粉厂车库开车到雇主在厂内的住所，等待所有孩子的到来。过了五分钟，雇主的妻子带着她的四个孩子，3个儿子和1个女儿，从厂舍出来并上了车。雇主的长子坐在前排我旁边，其余的人坐在后排。离开工厂区域后，我驾车沿莫干山路向西行驶。上午8时30分左右，到达莫干山路和唐山路路口时，我放慢车速准备向南转入唐山路，这时一名中国

pages.en:
Sheet 2.

Chinese suddenly appeared in the front of the car. Producing
a black pistol, he ordered me to stop the vehicle for a search.
Meanwhile, 3 other male Chinese, all armed with pistols,
approached the car from both sides, one from my side (right)
and two from the other side (left). They opened the doors of
the car and ordered all of us to alight for a search. After
we all left the vehicle, the two armed men on the left side
pulled out the oldest son of my employer and entered the rear
of the car, while the armed man on the right took my seat
and the other in front entered the front of the car. The
motor car was quickly driven away by the armed man who
intimidated me at the right side.

Following the incident, I immediately returned to the
mill for the purpose of making a report and when reaching a
distance of 40 yards west of the mill, I met a C.P.C. to whom
I made a report accordingly.

The description of the armed men is as follows:

1. Age about 25/26, height about 5'8", medium build, round face,
dark complexion, long hair brushed back, wearing blue,
jacket and pants. Northern Dialect. Armed.

2. Age about 26/27, height 5'7", medium build, long face, dark
complexion, long hair brushed back, wearing white shirt and
blue pants. Northern Dialect. Armed.

3. Age about 25, height about 5'6", slim build, long hair
brushed back, round face, wearing blue jacket and pants.
Northern Dialect. Armed.

4. Age about 26, height about 5'6", thin build, round thin
peak marked face, dark complexion, wearing blue jacket
and pants. Northern Dialect. Armed.

This is my true statement.

Signed. Sun Kang Sung.
pages.zh:
第2页。

男性突然出现在车前。他掏出一把黑色手枪，命令我停车接受搜查。与此同时，另外三名中国男性，均手持手枪，从两侧接近汽车，一人从我的一侧（右侧），两人从另一侧（左侧）。他们打开车门，命令我们所有人下车接受搜查。当我们都离开车辆后，左侧的两名持枪男子将我雇主的长子拉出并进入车后座，而右侧的持枪男子坐了我的位置，另一人进入车前部。汽车很快被右侧恐吓我的那名持枪男子开走。

事件发生后，我立即返回工厂进行报告，在到达工厂以西40码处时，我遇到了一名巡捕，并向他作了相应报告。

持枪男子的体貌特征如下：

1. 年龄约25/26岁，身高约5英尺8英寸，中等身材，圆脸，
肤色黝黑，长发向后梳，身穿蓝色，
夹克和长裤。北方口音。持有武器。

2. 年龄约26/27岁，身高5英尺7英寸，中等身材，长脸，肤色
黝黑，长发向后梳，身穿白衬衫和
蓝色长裤。北方口音。持有武器。

3. 年龄约25岁，身高约5英尺6英寸，身材瘦削，长发
向后梳，圆脸，身穿蓝色夹克和长裤。
北方口音。持有武器。

4. 年龄约26岁，身高约5英尺6英寸，身材瘦削，圆而瘦的
麻子脸，肤色黝黑，身穿蓝色夹克
和长裤。北方口音。持有武器。

这是我的真实陈述。

签名。孙康生（Sun Kang Sung，音译，注：前文自称Zau Kung Sung曹根生，此处签名拼音不同，可能是笔误或别名，照实译出）。

pages.en:
C.P.C. 901 Zau Voong Tsing.
                                          himself.
Pootoo Rd Stn           12.9.40.          translated    Clerk Chin Hung Keng.
                                          xxxxxxxx

Sir,

        I beg to report that at about 8.35 a.m. 12.9.40. whilst
I was on duty at the corner of Robison and Ferry Roads outside
the Lau Fu Vung Silver Smith Shop, I saw a motor car 3.H.C.
Lic. No. 4981 which was proceeding from east to west along
Robison Road, turn south into Ferry Road. When reaching
outside the 5 3z Tseng Macaroni Shop, the car collided with
a female Chinese and knocked her down. The scene of the
accident was about 50 yards away from me. On seeing this,
I immediately went to investigate and when approaching the car
about 10 yards, I heard the report of one shot fired by
occupants inside the car. I then loaded my service pistol,
blew my whistle and chased after the vehicle which was driven
away in fast speed. On arriving at Mpai Road, the car had
passed the Shou Xing Hospital and disappeared. I then
telephoned the station.

        When I returned to the scene of the accident, I found
that the injured female had gone.

                                    Signed. Zau Voong Tsing.
pages.zh:
巡捕901号 赵永清（Zau Voong Tsing，音译）。
                                          本人。
普陀路站           1940年9月12日。          翻译    职员 陈洪康（Chin Hung Keng，音译）。
                                          xxxxxxxx

先生，

        谨报告，1940年9月12日上午8时35分左右，当我在罗宾逊路和斐伦路路口的老凤祥银楼（Lau Fu Vung Silver Smith Shop，音译，老凤祥通常译Lao Feng Xiang，此处Lau Fu Vung可能是旧式拼写或另一家店，照实译或按通例。老凤祥是著名银楼，Lau Fu Vung读音接近。暂译为老凤祥银楼）外执勤时，我看到一辆车牌号为4981的机动车（3.H.C.，原文如此，疑为S.H.C.或R.H.C.，照实保留）沿罗宾逊路从东向西行驶，向南转入斐伦路。当到达五三增面馆（5 3z Tseng Macaroni Shop，原文不清，“5 3z”可能是门牌号或店名一部分，Tseng可能是曾，Macaroni Shop即面馆/意面店）外时，该车撞倒了一名中国女性。事故现场距离我约50码。看到这一幕，我立即前去调查，当接近汽车约10码时，我听到车内乘客开了一枪。于是我给配枪装上子弹，吹响哨子，追赶那辆快速驶离的车辆。到达麦皮路（Mpai Road，音译，疑为Maipai或类似，上海有麦根路Morgan Rd，麦赛尔蒂埃路Route Marcel，此处Mpai可能是OCR错误，如Nanyi Rd在前文出现过。照实译Mpai路）时，该车已过守兴医院（Shou Xing Hospital，音译，前文p1为Shou Ming Hospital守明医院，此处不一致，照实译守兴医院）并消失。随后我打电话回警局。

        当我返回事故现场时，发现受伤的女性已经离开。

                                    签名。赵永清（Zau Voong Tsing，音译）。

pages.en:
C.P.C. 2137 Ma Zung Sai.
himself.
translated
Foofoo Rd Stn    12.9.40.    XXXXXX    Clerk Chia Hung Kong.

Sir,

I beg to report that I was on 1st day duty from
7 a.m. and 11 a.m. on 12.9.40. When reporting for duty,
I was detailed to walk No. 3 and 4 beats.

At 8.25 a.m. even date, whilst patrolling along
Mokanshan Road, I saw a female Chinese, a male Chinese and
two children running east towards me in an excited manner.
I inquired of them what had happened, the male Chinese
replied that his employer's son had been kidnapped. He told
me that he is a chauffeur and that the kidnappers had gone,
having driven the motor car S.H.C. Lic. No. 4981. I immediately
informed the station of the occurrence through a street
telephone following which I accompanied the chauffeur to the
station.

Signed. Ma Zung Sai.
pages.zh:
巡捕2137号 马宗赛（Ma Zung Sai，音译）。
本人。
翻译
斐伦路站    1940年9月12日。    XXXXXX    职员 陈洪康（Chia Hung Kong，音译，前文为Chin，此处为Chia，照实译）。

先生，

谨报告，1940年9月12日，我从上午7时至11时执行第一班勤务。报到时，我被指派巡逻第3和第4警区。

当天上午8时25分，我在莫干山路巡逻时，看到一名中国女性、一名中国男性和两个孩子兴奋地向东朝我跑来。我询问他们发生了什么事，这名中国男性回答说他雇主的儿子被绑架了。他告诉我他是司机，绑架者已驾驶车牌号为4981的汽车离开。我立即通过街边电话向警局报告了此事，随后陪同司机前往警局。

签名。马宗赛（Ma Zung Sai，音译）。
